description: This file defines the function shapeStackedSeries which processes an array of cost records into a dataset suitable for plotting stacked series charts, specifically tailored for use with Recharts. It aggregates costs by service and category or environment, filling in zeroes where data is missing.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a dataset formatted for stacked chart visualization, grouping by specified categories and optionally sorting the data.
